The '''Battle of Aargonar''' was a loss for the Republic, but not a catastrophic one. Just days after the disastrous [[Battle of Jabiim]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]], [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], [[Bhat Jul]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were redeployed to [[Aargonar/Legends|Aargonar]], an insignificant planet save for the fact it lay on the border of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

==The Battle==
Just like the Battle of [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], the battle fared poorly for Republic forces, with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Jul killed in action, alongside many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Mundi, temporarily charged with Mastery of Anakin Skywalker following the supposed death of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on Jabiim, gave the order to retreat from his gunship in the skies. Bultar Swan, telling Mundi that the sandstorm was ion-charged and that this battle could be worse than Jabiim, immediately attempted to destroy the Republic's camp to prevent their supplies from falling into Separatist hands, not knowing that Anakin and A'Sharad were still out in the deserts of Aargonar.<ref name="R59">[[Republic 59|''Republic'' 59]]</ref>

[[File:BathDead.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The death of [[Bhat Jul]].]]

The two Jedi would attempt to seek shelter in a cavern, only for them to be attacked by a [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] before it was eaten in turn by a [[gouka dragon]]. Escaping through the cave created by the gouka, Anakin accidentally attacked Hett as a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] due to a berserk rage he was undergoing, nearly killing him. Burdened, Anakin revealed the truth of his slaughter of Tuskens on Tatooine prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] to Hett. Hett agreed that it was a dragon Anakin would have to fight on his own—and kept his secret.

The two Jedi managed to find a disabled [[Gunship Bomber]] Enhanced and used it to lure a native gouka into the Separatist army, giving the Republic time to retreat and rescue the two young Jedi. The Republic managed a successful retreat, and the surviving Jedi returned to [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]].

Word of a victory on Aargonar reached the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], as part of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] plan to make the Republic seem more successful in the war than it actually was.<ref name="R61">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref>
